Proposal Evaluation A two-stage procedure will be adopted in evaluation of the proposals: i. Technical evaluation, which will be carried out prior to opening any financial proposal ii. Financial evaluation, each firm will be ranked using a combined technical and financial score Technical Proposal (St) The evaluation committee or team appointed by INRPC, NRB, BARC will evaluate the proposals on the basi s of their responsiveness to the requirements specified in Tender Document, applying the evaluation criter ia, sub-criteria and point system specified in the Data Sheet. Each responsive proposal will be attributed a technical score (St). A proposal shall be rejected at this stage if it does not respond to important aspects of the tender requirements or if it fails to achieve the minimum technical score set out. Note: The technical proposal should score at least 70% to be considered for financial evaluation and minim um 70% in individual criteria also.

Financial Proposal (Sf) After the evaluation of Technical Proposals, concerned authority shall notify the date and time set for openi ng of Financial Proposals. The notification may be sent by email / corrigendum. The evaluation committee or team will determine if the Financial Proposals are without computational errors. The evaluation shall incl ude those taxes, duties, levies applicable under the law. Incomplete proposals shall be liable for rejection Final Evaluation of Bids shall be as under: The final selection shall be based on QCBS (Quality and Cost based Selection). The cost indicated in the fin ancial bid shall be deemed as final and reflecting the total cost of services and should be stated in INR onl y. • The lowest Financial Bid (Fm) will be given a financial score (Sf) of 100 points. • The financial scores of the financial bids will be determined using the following formula: Sf = 100 * Fm/F; where Sf is the financial score, Fm is the lowest financial bid, and F is the financial bid of the seller under co nsideration. • Bids will finally be ranked in accordance with their combined technical (St) and financial (Sf) scores: S= St * Tw + Sf * Fw; Where S is the combined score, and Tw and Fw are weights assigned to technical and financial bids respect ively that will be 70: 30. • The bidder achieving the highest combined technical and financial score will be considered to be succe ssful applicant and work shall be awarded to them through a Letter of Award (LoA). 29. Special Terms and Conditions for Milestone Deliverables and Offline Payment Processing: Payment Basis and Execution Workflow: This contract is executed on a Lumpsum / Milestone-Based payment framework across two milestones. Bi dders must quote an all-inclusive single consolidated Lumpsum Financial Cost (inclusive of GST) on the pri mary bidding screen. The split of payments is fixed at 50% for Milestone 1 and 50% for Milestone 2. Milestone 1: Incorporation of initial comments after submission of Initial Drafts (50% Payment Allocation) • Operational Requirement: The Service Provider must submit the initial drafts of all required deliverables (as stated in Point 5 of scope of work) offline (via physical copy and official email) directly to the designate d Nodal Officer. • Review Framework: The Buyer Department will run its internal technical evaluation, committee reviews, and feedback cycles entirely offline. • Portal Restriction: The Service Provider is strictly prohibited from marking this milestone as "Delivered" o r uploading invoices on the GeM portal until the Buyer Department completes its verification and issues a f ormal written approval notification. Milestone 2: Final Acceptance and Contract Closing (50% Payment Allocation) • Operational Requirement: The Service Provider must fully incorporate all structural, technical, and admin istrative feedback provided by the buyer's internal committee and resubmit the final documents offline. • Portal Restriction: The online delivery action on GeM shall only be executed after the Competent Authorit y issues the final manual, offline "Deliverable Acceptance Certificate". Payment Processing: • Payment Processing: All financial transactions, billing verifications, and milestone disbursements under t his contract will be managed through the Buyer Department’s offline accounting channels. .
